note: Zrinjski 4–3 AZ, Conference League group E, matchday 1, Mostar, 21 September 2023. Quotes from Dutch, Croatian and Slovenian outlets are printed in English translation and say so; headlines are printed as the outlet printed them, with a translation underneath. The owner was in the stand: his photos and phone clips are marked as his.
